inputs.name: hazard selection budget
inputs.transformation: Eviction comparison budget; not operational threshold
inputs.uncertainty: Deliberately hypothetical/operator policy; not an observed universal bound

inputs.name: ocs cube chips
inputs.transformation: Default cube geometry 4x4x4 = 64 chips, from the TPU v4 block; a parameter (OCSConfig.geometry)
inputs.uncertainty: Other generations use other cube sizes; every OCS table moves with it

inputs.name: ocs usable ports
inputs.transformation: 128 of 136 ports in use; each cube takes a + and a - port per switch, so one domain holds ports/2 cubes
inputs.uncertainty: Current hardware may differ; the experiment also reports 64 and 32 ports and uses 136 for the spare-cube case

inputs.name: ocs max cubes per axis
inputs.transformation: Super-slice shape cap chosen to match the static pod's 16-chip axes; stands in for GKE's shape list, which is not modelled
inputs.uncertainty: Deliberately hypothetical; the cap alone moves the cube-aligned gap from 0% to 2-10%

results.name: geometry bound
results.transformation: Cordon loss is half where an even extent provides that bound; odd-only 3x3x3 can lose 18/27
results.uncertainty: Scope and qualifications stated in transformation and linked source; no unreported confidence interval
results.statement: Cordon loss is half where an even extent provides that bound; odd-only 3x3x3 can lose 18/27

results.name: hazard scope
results.transformation: Titan external failure history anchors hazard only, not torus packing, modern accelerator failure or actual scheduler throughput
results.uncertainty: Scope and qualifications stated in transformation and linked source; no unreported confidence interval
results.statement: Titan external failure history anchors hazard only, not torus packing, modern accelerator failure or actual scheduler throughput

results.name: geometry conservation
results.transformation: Rectangular placement/isolation is an idealized topology model with no empirical packing anchor
results.uncertainty: Scope and qualifications stated in transformation and linked source; no unreported confidence interval
results.statement: Rectangular placement/isolation is an idealized topology model with no empirical packing anchor

results.name: ocs cube-aligned gap
results.transformation: On matched seeds, OCS with any cube shape leaves 0% of free chips unusable for cube-aligned jobs at 10-85% occupancy, also after a matched third of jobs depart; the static torus leaves 8.0-32.3% (43.3% after departures)
results.uncertainty: Scope and qualifications stated in transformation and linked source; no unreported confidence interval
results.statement: On matched seeds, OCS with any cube shape leaves 0% of free chips unusable for cube-aligned jobs at 10-85% occupancy, also after a matched third of jobs depart; the static torus leaves 8.0-32.3% (43.3% after departures)

results.name: ocs no-benefit cases
results.transformation: The gap returns under OCS with a 4-cubes-per-axis cap (1.7-10.4%), with sub-cube jobs (up to 5.4% with any shape) and with port limits (52.8% at 32 ports, 40% occupancy); sizes that are not whole cubes are refused
results.uncertainty: Scope and qualifications stated in transformation and linked source; no unreported confidence interval
results.statement: The gap returns under OCS with a 4-cubes-per-axis cap (1.7-10.4%), with sub-cube jobs (up to 5.4% with any shape) and with port limits (52.8% at 32 ports, 40% occupancy); sizes that are not whole cubes are refused

results.name: ocs spare-cube recovery
results.transformation: With a spare cube in the domain one chip failure costs a 4,096-chip slice 0 chips at every location (static 256-2,048) and costs the pod one 64-chip cube; borrowing a spare succeeded for 30 of 40 failures at 95% occupancy, reserving two cubes for 40 of 40
results.uncertainty: Scope and qualifications stated in transformation and linked source; no unreported confidence interval
results.statement: With a spare cube in the domain one chip failure costs a 4,096-chip slice 0 chips at every location (static 256-2,048) and costs the pod one 64-chip cube; borrowing a spare succeeded for 30 of 40 failures at 95% occupancy, reserving two cubes for 40 of 40

results.name: ocs ring derivation
results.transformation: A stitched slice has a ring on an axis only where a closing circuit is configured on every line; the chip graph is built from the circuit list and its diameter matches the k-ary n-cube closed forms
results.uncertainty: Scope and qualifications stated in transformation and linked source; no unreported confidence interval
results.statement: A stitched slice has a ring on an axis only where a closing circuit is configured on every line; the chip graph is built from the circuit list and its diameter matches the k-ary n-cube closed forms

results.name: ocs scope
results.transformation: The OCS model is unmeasured: no real pod, OCS or slice controller; no time, switch, fibre or link failure; Google's up-to-5x start and up-to-4.5x recovery figures are vendor claims, not inputs, and are not checked
results.uncertainty: Scope and qualifications stated in transformation and linked source; no unreported confidence interval
results.statement: The OCS model is unmeasured: no real pod, OCS or slice controller; no time, switch, fibre or link failure; Google's up-to-5x start and up-to-4.5x recovery figures are vendor claims, not inputs, and are not checked
